text:
infra-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Spike from ~3% -> ~22% starting ~14:03Z. Paging on-call: @elaine_oncall. Dash: https://dash.redwood/alerts/5412346789

elaine_oncall: on it, I'm seeing large scheduler queue depth on gen-batch-usw2-1 and head-of-line blocking. Several requests stuck in batcher pending state > 6s.

aj_murphy: taking. quick check — are these concentrated on a single customer or broad? any recent deploys?

kim_rodriguez: CS: multiple PLG customers reported timeouts, several error reports from embedded clients. No deploys in last 30m on runtime.

sanjay_k: grabbing logs from the batcher pool, looks like KV cache growth + long compile latencies for some models. snippet: ```2026-03-15T14:04:12Z ERROR batcher: head_wait=6300ms pool=gen-batch-usw2-1 reqs=122 kv_miss=0.87```

elaine_oncall: ok infra decision: we need immediate relief. Options: (1) emergency eviction of oldest pending batches to break HOL, (2) throttle non-premium ingress at gateway, (3) fallback route to smaller model. I'll coordinate.

aj_murphy: do (1) + (2) concurrently. I can run eviction and ask infra to flip ingress throttles. @sanjay_k can you prepare eviction command?

sanjay_k: running eviction now. command: ```/opt/bin/batcher-ctl --pool gen-batch-usw2-1 --evict-oldest 40 --reason "HOL emergency"```

pagerduty-bot: @aj_murphy acknowledged the page. Escalation: 2nd on-call notified.

sanjay_k: eviction completed, returned 34 batches evicted (some already running). Observed immediate drop in head_wait to ~180ms for new batches.

elaine_oncall: flipping ingress throttle: applied qps cap 600 -> 300 for non-premium routes in us-west-2. Also enabling fallback route: /v1/generate -> model-compact-v1 for requests > 4s predicted latency.

aj_murphy: scaling batcher pool by +2 instances (hot-add) to increase throughput. Also tuned `max_wait_ms` down for heavy tenant routing.

kim_rodriguez: CS update: initial mitigation reduced customer errors; posting status to affected customers and enabling retry guidance.

aj_murphy: monitoring metrics — 5xx rate dropped from 22% -> 5.8% over 4 minutes, gateway timeouts reduce similarly. Queue depth trending down.

elaine_oncall: I'm handing off to @aj_murphy for post-mortem and RCA. Systems stable for now but keep page open for 30m monitoring. Creating follow-up ticket: INC-2026-142 to investigate batching scheduler parameter regression and KV cache growth correlation.

aj_murphy: noted. action items: collect batcher traces, per-tenant request size histograms, and run replay against staging for max_wait_ms variants.

sanjay_k: archived eviction logs and uploaded to incident artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/incidents/5412346789/evict-log.txt

elaine_oncall: thanks team. :white_check_mark: Closing live mitigation. If we see re-escalation reopen this thread.

kim_rodriguez: CS will follow up with affected customers and share any error payload samples to help with replay. :thumbsup:
